model_basis: Home Credit public dataset (Russia/Asia consumer credit, 2016-2018). NOT real CEMAC banking data. Promotion to PROD_CHAMPION requires retraining on proprietary bank data with signed data-sharing agreement — see OOT_VALIDATION_PACK.md §7.
oot_split_method: SK_ID_CURR chronological proxy (IDs 85-100%). NOT a calendar OOT window. Real OOT requires min. 6-month gap — see OOT_VALIDATION_PACK.md §1.
oot_period_note: Home Credit dataset IDs (top 15%). Fictitious 2025 calendar dates removed — dataset is 2016-2018.
mrm_comments: Model shows stable PSI (< 0.1) and discrimination above regulatory floors on Home Credit demo data. Slight under-calibration in high-risk tails noted; buffer applied at decision level (main.py). Self-Employed segment Gini ~38% is below the 45% floor — mandatory human review required for this segment. NOT a production validation.
